throws at it (computed sizes like `8 * 1024`, comprehensions, nested dicts) that
stricter parsers choke on. For the `plugin` key just import the module it names and
instantiate its `Transform`, so operators can drop in new plugins without touching the
loader. Wire it up that way to keep the loader small.
